title: ExtendedAE issue #638: [Bug] Error During Mod Loading
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-3.0) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Marioluigi7896]
Trying to include ExtendedAE in a modpack with a bunch of other mods, however when including the mod AE2 fails to load, disabling the mod fixes the issue. The reported issue in the crashlog seems to be a duplicate resource key, unsure if this will end up being an AE2 issue but since it only appeared with this mod enabled I figured I'd report here first.
``java.lang.IllegalStateException: Adding duplicate key 'ResourceKey[minecraft:menu / extendedae:ex_emc_import_bus]' to registry``

Mincraft Version: 1.21.1
Java Version: 21.0.3, Eclipse Adoptium
Mod Version: 1.21-2.2.34
Neoforge Version: 21.1.242
AE2 version: 19.2.17
Crash Log: 
https://gist.github.com/Marioluigi7896/eb11f3f9ae2d3f3d7851a1fe4eb1ce30

[comment by muggleorwizard (none)]
Confirmed, happening to me as well after updating NeoForge. 
https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/vOInh8p

As a note, this issue does not occur on NeoForge 21.1.236. It only occurs after updating past that version.

[comment by GlodBlock (owner)]
fixed
